title: Trance channeling EEG study
description: This EEG dataset comprises recordings from 13 screened participants across two sessions, featuring alternating 5-minute blocks of trance channeling and resting state conditions. The study design includes three periods per session for each condition, providing a structured investigation of neural activity during trance channeling states compared to baseline resting conditions.
methods_description: Participants underwent thorough screening and completed two sessions on different days. Each session consisted of alternating 5-minute blocks of trance channeling and resting state conditions, with three periods per session for each condition.
